overview_description.description: Fourier Intelligence is a Shanghai-based technology and design company providing exoskeleton robotic product and service on rehabilitation & orthoses. Its products include upper-limb rehab robotics and lower-limb exoskeleton robot, which can help the disabled go beyond of the physical limits, stand up and walk again. Its exoskeleton products can also decrease fatigue and increase productivity whilst unloading supplies or enabling workers/soldiers to carry heavy objects.

product.name: GRx Humanoid Robot Series
product.description: A family of bipedal, general-purpose humanoid robots for embodied-AI development, research, rehabilitation, commercial services, and industrial applications.

product.name: Fourier Rehab
product.description: A portfolio of robotic rehabilitation systems for physical therapy, including upper- and lower-body, balance, coordination, diagnosis, training, and treatment applications.

product.name: RehabHub™
product.description: An integrated rehabilitation platform combining solutions for upper- and lower-body therapy, balance, coordination, diagnosis, training, and treatment.

product.name: MetaMotus™ Galileo
product.description: A robotic movement and balance training system designed to support physical rehabilitation and assessment in clinical and institutional settings.

product.name: Fourier Dexterous Hand (FDH-6)
product.description: A dexterous robotic hand designed to provide humanoid robots and robotics developers with articulated hand manipulation capabilities.

product.name: Fourier Nexus
product.description: A robotics community and collaboration program supporting humanoid-robotics research, education, developer communication, and applied innovation.
